user.title: Connect to Adrient Workspace
user.description: Create a token in Adrient under Settings > API tokens with the "Connect Home Assistant" preset, then paste it here.

data_description.url: The address you open Adrient at, for example https://adrient.example.com.
data_description.token: A personal access token starting with grw_.

reauth_confirm.title: Adrient token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Adrient at {url} no longer accepts the token for {name}. Create a new token with the "Connect Home Assistant" preset and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Adrient Workspace
reconfigure.description: Change the Adrient URL. Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Adrient. Check the URL and that Home Assistant can reach it.
error.invalid_auth: Adrient rejected the token. Make sure it is valid and has the Home Assistant scopes.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL.

abort.already_configured: This Adrient account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Adrient account.
